subject: Confidentiality & Publicity — logo/reference language for MSA + Order Form
messages:
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novatech.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@novatech.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Publicity & logo use — proposed carveouts for order form

Hi David,

Thanks again for the productive call yesterday. Legal at Novatech has asked me to follow up with a short note about publicity/reference rights in the MSA + Order Form. Our security/compliance team is fine with the data terms, but marketing wants a simple right to mention the relationship and use the Redwood logo in a joint press release and on our website.

We are proposing the following limited language to add to the Order Form: 1) Novatech may use Redwood's logo and a brief description of the scope of the engagement for customer lists and a single press release; 2) Any press release will be shared with Redwood at least 10 business days prior to publication for review; 3) No other endorsements or case study text will be published without separate approval.

I've attached a one-page redline of the publicity paragraphs that our counsel prefers (Novatech_publicity_redline_v1.pdf). Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept those constraints and whether you need an embargo window or additional evidence (e.g., an approved quote) before we go to sign?

We can be flexible on timing — our launch target is mid‑May, so ideally we want language in the signed Order Form this month.

Thanks,
Marta Ruiz
Head of Partnerships, Novatech

Attachment: Novatech_publicity_redline_v1.pdf (pdf, 1 page)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@novatech.com>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@novatech.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Publicity & logo use — proposed carveouts for order form

Marta — thanks for the note and the redline. Looping in Kimberly (legal) and Laura (marketing) so we can review quickly. A few quick points from a product/sales perspective:

- We are comfortable with a single joint press release + logo use on a customer list page, provided the wording is factual and not an endorsement.
- We typically ask for a 30-day review window for complex launch materials (to coordinate PR approvals and prepare case study collateral) but can be flexible to 10 business days if Novatech needs that.
- Redwood prefers to retain a short right to publish an anonymized case study or performance snapshot unless Novatech wants to opt out; we can make that opt‑out explicit in the Order Form.

Kimberly — if you can propose final language (short paragraph to insert into the Order Form / MSA publicity schedule) that preserves Redwood's ability to reference the relationship in an anonymized form and keeps the embargo window variable, that'd be ideal. Laura — I put you on the thread to confirm the quote approval flow.

I'll also attach our internal tracker that shows a few previous publicity clauses we use so you can see typical wording.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_MSA_publicity_tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet, list of prior clauses)

Subject: RE: Publicity & logo use — proposed carveouts for order form

David, team — thanks for looping me in. I reviewed Novatech's redline and drafted concise language that I believe balances both parties' needs. Key points in the proposed clause:

1) Permitted uses: Customer may use Redwood's name and logo solely to identify Redwood as a vendor in Novatech's customer list and in one mutually‑approved press release.
2) Review & timing: Customer will provide a copy of any release to Redwood at least 10 business days prior to publication for review solely for factual accuracy and to coordinate timing; Redwood will not unreasonably withhold approval for factual content.
3) Quotes & endorsements: Any endorsement quotes or case study content require separate written approval and a mutually agreed draft.
4) Embargo / launch coordination: If the parties agree to a joint product launch, the parties will negotiate a mutually acceptable embargo window; absent agreement, Redwood requests up to 30 calendar days for internal readiness but will use reasonable efforts to meet Customer deadlines.
5) Anonymized reference: Redwood may use anonymized, aggregated performance data and a generic reference to the Customer relationship for marketing purposes unless Customer opts out in writing on the Order Form.

I've attached a redline with the exact paragraph and a one‑sentence opt‑out box you can include in the Order Form. If Novatech is comfortable with the opt‑out approach for anonymized references, I think this resolves the remaining concerns while protecting Redwood's ability to run product marketing.

Proposed attachment: Redwood_publicity_clause_v1.docx (language + opt‑out snippet). I'll send the docx to you separately via SharePoint if you prefer.

LMK if Novatech legal would like any small edits; otherwise we can accept the Novatech redline with the addition of the anonymized reference opt‑out.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Redwood_publicity_clause_v1.docx (word, 1 page)
